choice_prompt:3:1010102001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你的脸色很凝重，发生什么事了？

say:4:1010102002:1.text: Well... Ryeham should never have been divided. Now the citizens on both sides of the river are constantly bickering.
say:4:1010102002:1.source_cn: 嗯……金穗村本不该有南北之分，如今河岸两边的居民却矛盾重重。
say:4:1010102002:1.male: Well... Ryeham should never have been divided. Now the citizens on both sides of the river are constantly bickering.
say:4:1010102002:1.female: Well... Ryeham should never have been divided. Now the citizens on both sides of the river are constantly bickering.

say:5:1010102003:1.text: I have to point out that this situation started after Lord Franz arrived in Ryeham.
say:5:1010102003:1.source_cn: 我必须多提一嘴，这种情况是从弗朗茨来金穗村后开始的。
say:5:1010102003:1.male: I have to point out that this situation started after Lord Franz arrived in Ryeham.
say:5:1010102003:1.female: I have to point out that this situation started after Lord Franz arrived in Ryeham.

say:6:1010102004:1.text: I heard that Lord Franz has always wanted to grow grapes in Northville to increase production.
say:6:1010102004:1.source_cn: 我听说过，弗朗茨一直很想把葡萄种到北村去，扩大产量。
say:6:1010102004:1.male: I heard that Lord Franz has always wanted to grow grapes in Northville to increase production.
say:6:1010102004:1.female: I heard that Lord Franz has always wanted to grow grapes in Northville to increase production.

say:7:1010102005:1.text: What...? This is the first I've heard of that.
say:7:1010102005:1.source_cn: 什么……这我是第一次听说。
say:7:1010102005:1.male: What...? This is the first I've heard of that.
say:7:1010102005:1.female: What...? This is the first I've heard of that.

say:8:1010102006:1.text: In short, the intel suggests that the culprit is probably someone other than the Scarlet Sorceress.
say:8:1010102006:1.source_cn: 总而言之，种种情报表明，纵火犯很可能不是灰烬魔女，而是...

say:9:1010102007:1.text: Uh...she's still a suspect, and who knows if the other red-headed mage is her accomplice. We'll have to keep investigating.
say:9:1010102007:1.source_cn: 但她仍有嫌疑，说不定另一位红发女魔法师是她的同伙，我们...

say:10:1010102008:1.text: Hmph... We haven't even solved the issue of the changing weather, but here comes more problems.
say:10:1010102008:1.source_cn: 唉……气候异变的问题还没解决，又来了一桩麻烦事。

say:11:1010102009:1.text: This case is related to magic, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, which Valen does not excel at. I'm going to ask you for your help.
say:11:1010102009:1.male: This case is related to magic, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, which Valen does not excel at. I'm going to ask you for your help.
say:11:1010102009:1.female: This case is related to magic, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, which Valen does not excel at. I'm going to ask you for your help.

say:12:1010102010:1.text: Are you willing to aid us?

say:14:1010102011:1.source_cn: 这番话，我会转达给她的。
say:14:1010102011:1.male: I'll let her know that you said that.
say:14:1010102011:1.female: I'll let her know that you said that.

say:15:1010102015:1.text: Thanks for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Have you figured out what your next move is?

say:16:1010102016:1.text: We ought to look around Southville. Before identifying the culprit, we should learn more about the grape variety known as Gemvine.
say:16:1010102016:1.source_cn: 我们打算去南村看看。在揪出纵火犯的真凶前，我们想见识见...

say:17:1010102017:1.text: We bumped into Lord Franz just now, and he wasn't particularly friendly.
say:17:1010102017:1.source_cn: 就在刚才，我们和弗朗茨打过照面了，他的态度可不怎么友好。

say:18:1010102018:1.text: What if... hypothetically, my sword falls out of its scabbard, completely by accident, mind you... and skewers his foot? You'd protect me, right?
say:18:1010102018:1.source_cn: 万一……我是说，万一我的剑不小心从剑鞘里掉出来，刚好扎...

say:19:1010102019:0.text: ... Please keep an eye on him, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'm afraid he's going to get into trouble.
